name: Japan (Fuji)
region: Mount Fuji and the Japanese Alps.
sources: Japan Meteorological Agency climate normals 1991-2020, Fujisan station
Hersbach, H. et al. (2020) The ERA5 global reanalysis. QJRMS 146:1999-2049 (monthly climatology 1991-2020, 300 hPa winds)
notes: The winter jet over Japan is among the strongest on Earth; official climbing season is July to early September. Summit precipitation is poorly measured.
